note: Simple Mega Menu defines a fieldable/revisionable/translatable content entity 'simple_mega_menu' with a config bundle entity 'simple_mega_menu_type' (config prefix simple_megamenu.simple_mega_menu_type, key field targetMenu = list of menu machine names it applies to). A menu link content item in a targeted menu gets a Simple Mega Menu entity-autocomplete; the chosen entity id is stored on the link options as attributes['data-simple-mega-menu']. Rendering is via two Twig functions has_megamenu(url) and view_megamenu(url, view_mode); shipped view modes 'before' and 'after'. No global settings page (configure=null). Medium/hard cases use namespaced bundles (smm_known/smm_probe/smm_task/smm_ct) and exercise the real targetMenu config and simple_mega_menu entity storage.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal simple_megamenu module, which two Twig functions render or detect a mega menu attached to a menu link, and what does each do?
evals.expected_output: has_megamenu(url) returns TRUE when the menu link's Url carries an attached mega menu (the data-simple-mega-menu attribute), and view_megamenu(url, view_mode) renders the attached simple_mega_menu entity in the given view mode (e.g. 'before' or 'after').

evals.prompt: How does simple_megamenu associate a mega menu entity with a specific menu link in Drupal, and where is that association stored?
evals.expected_output: On the menu link content edit form (for links in a targeted menu) it adds a Simple Mega Menu entity-autocomplete; the selected entity id is stored on the menu link's link options as attributes['data-simple-mega-menu'].

evals.prompt: In simple_megamenu, what decides on which menus a given mega menu type (bundle) can be used, and what is the config property called?
evals.expected_output: Each simple_mega_menu_type bundle has a targetMenu property - a list of menu machine names. The mega-menu autocomplete only appears on menu links whose menu is listed in some bundle's targetMenu.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Simple mega menu type (bundle) with machine name 'smm_known'. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which menu it is set to apply to (its target menu).
evals.expected_output: smm_known targets the 'main' menu: simple_megamenu.simple_mega_menu_type.smm_known targetMenu contains 'main'. Read with drush cget simple_megamenu.simple_mega_menu_type.smm_known.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a Simple mega menu entity has been created in the 'smm_probe' bundle. Inspect the live simple_mega_menu entities and report the name of that entity.
evals.expected_output: The entity's name is 'SMM Known Panel' (bundle smm_probe). Find it via the simple_mega_menu storage, e.g. loadByProperties(['type' => 'smm_probe']) or the /admin/content/simple_mega_menu list.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Simple mega menu type (bundle) 'smm_task' exists but is not attached to any menu. Configure it so that it applies to the 'main' menu, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the smm_task bundle's targetMenu to include 'main' (edit the mega menu type at /admin/structure/simple_mega_menu_type or set targetMenu on simple_megamenu.simple_mega_menu_type.smm_task), then save.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Simple mega menu type called 'smm_ct'. Create a new Simple mega menu entity of that type named exactly 'SMM Promo', and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a simple_mega_menu entity with type 'smm_ct' and name 'SMM Promo' (via /admin/content/simple_mega_menu/add/smm_ct or SimpleMegaMenu::create(['type' => 'smm_ct', 'name' => 'SMM Promo'])->save()).
